howto: Move the paddle with your finger, the mouse or the arrow keys.
Keep the ball in play and bounce it into the 42 bricks.
Where the ball hits the paddle sets its angle: the ends send it off sharply.
Clear every brick to win. You lose a life each time the ball drops past the paddle.
tips: Bricks broken in quick succession build a combo: each one is worth 10 x the combo.
Get the ball above the bricks and it bounces around the top breaking them for you.
The ball speeds up slightly on every paddle hit, so centre hits buy you time.
The arrow keys move the paddle 25 px per press; hold them to glide.

controls.keyboard: Left and Right arrows move the paddle; Space launches and restarts. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Slide your finger across the game to move the paddle; tap to launch. Pause button top left.

difficulty: Easy gives 5 lives and a slower ball, Normal 3 lives, Hard 2 lives and a faster ball. Pick it on the title screen.

cheats.effect: The ball glows orange and smashes straight through bricks without bouncing

features.one-tap-start: Tap or press Space on the title card
features.instant-restart: Tap once on the GAME OVER or ALL CLEAR! card
features.best-score-badge: BEST under the score, top left
features.tutorial-card: First-run How to play card with an animated slide gesture; replay from Pause > How to play
features.results: GAME OVER / ALL CLEAR! card with score and best
